nina_cs: Heads-up — Verdant Bio (trial) asked for a Brazil-region peering + demo-only burst allowance. They want header HMAC validation + IPv6-only path for a proof-of-concept. Can eng help triage?

lucas_ops: Important: are they on Hosted or Dedicated? IPv6-only path might require edge rule checks.

nina_cs: Hosted for now. Customer contact: paola@verdant.bio. Window requested: 2026-05-12 08:00 -> 2026-05-12 20:00 (local Brasilia time). Expected sustained ~120 QPS, peak demo bursts to 450 for ~5-10m each.

mohit_net: We can provision an IPv6 route and add an allowlist for their /32. They provided: 2001:db8:85a3::/32 (test range). They also want an X-VB-SIGN header HMAC using SHA256 with a rotating key.

sara_pm: Renewal touchpoint in June — this pilot could influence conversion. Capture latency and cost metrics, and ask for a short post-demo survey.

lucas_ops: Risks: demo bursts could cause cross-tenant KV cache thrash. Propose: temporary per-customer soft cap with an emergency manual throttle, billing cap of $2k for the window to avoid surprise charges, and enable prefix caching for repeated prompts.

mohit_net: Edge proxy snippet for the team: ```
edge_route: sa-east1
allowlist_ipv6: ["2001:db8:85a3::/32"]
header_hmac: { "header": "X-VB-SIGN", "algo": "HMAC-SHA256", "key_id": "vb-demo-2026-05", "rotate_every": "12h" }
rate_limit: { "sustained_qps": 120, "burst_qps": 450, "burst_window_sec": 600 }
auto_revoke: true
```
Note: will only validate HMAC equality; we do not store keys — customer must provide and rotate.

deploy-bot: Created ticket CS-2401: "Verdant Bio IPv6 peering + HMAC header demo". Owners: lucas_ops, mohit_net.

lucas_ops: Plan: canary to 5% traffic 2 hours before demo, monitor 95p latency, error rate, token burn. If green, ramp to 100% for demo window. Post-window auto-cleanup scheduled.

sara_pm: I'll assemble a 6-check eval (latency p50/p95, token-cost delta, route correctness, HMAC failures, error spikes, customer satisfaction). Will run daily after the demo and attach notes to CS-2401.

nina_cs: I'll send the acceptance email and a short data handling consent. Also confirm they accept the $2k billing cap and key rotation schedule.

mohit_net: Quick technical ask — do we have a lightweight HMAC validator in the hosted proxy? If not, I can drop a small lambda in front of the edge.

lucas_ops: We have header equality checks; HMAC validator is a 2h dev task. Could do a temporary lambda. Keep it ephemeral.

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: CS-2401-demo 2026-05-12T10:00Z, reminders for owners 24h and 1h before.

nina_cs: Assignments: nina (customer comms + consent), lucas (ops rollout + billing cap), mohit (edge + HMAC validator), sara (eval + renewal notes).

mohit_net: After demo ends, will rotate key to invalidate and confirm allowlist removal. Also will export usage snapshot for billing.

lucas_ops: I'll add an emergency throttle command to the runbook: `rb throttle cs-2401 --qps 50` and tag on-call.

sara_pm: Reminder — capture any customer feedback about perceived latency from Brazil region vs us-east to inform routing decisions.

nina_cs: Closing loop — once keys & consent are in CS-2401, we'll proceed with the canary rollout. Thanks.
